selection_rationale: c2026-001 directly targets the highest-priority gap (G1/Q1) with a falsifiable, quantitative design, strong venue relevance, and a passing critic verdict. It yields reproducible binary outcomes (harmful vs non-harmful) amenable to paired analysis and supports downstream work (metrics, HITL, verification). Key supporting records include the candidate's cited literature (below).
unresolved_uncertainties: Validator fidelity: emulator/model checker behavior vs production device semantics and resulting bias in harm labels.
Corpus representativeness: public/synthetic configs may not reflect real operator intents and proprietary vendor features.
Oracle "harmful" label definition: severity thresholds and invariant selection (reachability/isolation) may be contested.
Repair-loop dynamics: appropriate iteration cap N and stopping rules may hide slow-converging or divergent repairs.
Multi-vendor semantic coverage: modeling vendor-specific CLI/ACL semantics may cause inconsistent evaluation across vendors.
LLM/prompt sensitivity: outcome variance across models and prompt templates may limit generalizability.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify concrete validator implementations and versions (e.g., Batfish, Mininet/emulator, vendor-specific models); document known semantics/limitations.
Pre-register dataset sources with permanent links, inclusion/exclusion rules, sampling procedure, and public splits (train/validation/held-out vendors).
Precisely define the oracle "harmful" label: list invariants tested (reachability/isolation/ACL semantics), severity thresholds, and how oracle verdicts are produced.
Pre-register repair-loop details: exact prompt templates, iteration cap N, stopping rules, retry policy, temperature/seeding, and random seeds for reproducibility.
Add and pre-register sensitivity analyses: validator-fidelity (e.g., compare syntactic vs emulator vs high-fidelity), dataset-source variation, and repair-cap sweeps; log validator disagreements.
Define handling of vendor-specific features and how discrepancies will be recorded/treated (exclude, normalize, or vendor-stratified analysis).
Prespecify statistical analysis details: primary tests (McNemar), effect-size measures, CI methods, multiple-comparison handling, and minimum sample-size justification.
Prespecify infrastructure/compute budget, maximum model calls, caching policies, and retry rules for provider/API failures to distinguish technical vs scientific failures.
